articles.title: The cooling challenge
paragraphs: Liquid cooling moves heat from a component into a controlled fluid circuit when air cooling alone cannot meet the thermal requirement.

articles.title: Cold plate architecture
paragraphs: ITS develops pressed-in tube and machined-channel cold plates. The selection depends on performance, cost, size, flow routing and manufacturing needs.

paragraphs: Design inputs commonly include heat load, component map, allowable temperatures, coolant, flow rate, pressure-drop target, inlet temperature and space constraints.

articles.title: Materials and interfaces

/capabilities/friction-stir-welding.title: Friction stir welding for demanding cold plates. | ITS Cooling
/capabilities/friction-stir-welding.description: A solid-state joining process used to seal complex aluminium thermal assemblies without melting the base material.

sections.heading: Friction stir welding for demanding cold plates.

articles.title: How the process works
paragraphs: A rotating non-consumable tool engages the joint, generates frictional heat and moves plasticized material along the seam while the material remains below its melting point.

articles.title: Why it matters for cold plates
paragraphs: Machined internal channels must be closed with a controlled, repeatable joint. FSW supports high-integrity seams while limiting the distortion associated with fusion welding.

articles.title: Integrated manufacturing
paragraphs: Channel machining, weld planning, tooling, finishing and verification are coordinated as one manufacturing route.

articles.title: Quality
paragraphs: Joint and leak-verification requirements are established from the drawing, application and project quality plan. Ratings are not assumed or published without project data.

sections.heading: Precision machining that enables thermal performance.

articles.title: Geometry with a purpose

articles.title: Production confidence
